summary: XFP501/X/CON Main panel and the Context Plus XFP 2 Loop 32 Zone model XFP502/X/CON Main panel at remote parts of a site (e.g. all potential fire service entrances).
description: Offers all of the functions and controls of an XFP Main panel (access levels 1, 2 and 3).
Requires its own dedicated Mains power and battery back-up supply.
A maximum of eight XFP510-32/CON Repeaters can be connected to one non-networked XFP Main panel.

Communication between the XFP Main panel and Repeater requires an AFP711 network driver card (fitted as standard in all XFP510-32/CON repeaters, available as an optional extra on Main XFP 1 loop 32 zone model XFP501/X/CON and the Main XFP 2 Loop 32 Zone model XFP502/X/CON).
Repeater network is non-redundant and wired in 1.5 mm2 two-core screened fire resistant cable. Network length must not exceed 500 metres.
